title: FA3 MCP Control Chat
purpose: Natural-language intent capture and operator-facing orchestration surface for FA3 MCP-controlled desktop/DCC/editor applications.

authority_chain.rule: Capture intent, attachments, target and risk hint only.
Produce typed capability calls; adapter required.
Existing central policy authority classifies and admits capabilities.
Existing approval authority gates mutating/destructive/external-side-effect operations.
Existing central MCP mediation is the sole tool-routing boundary.
App-specific MCP adapter executes only admitted typed calls.
Existing observability/evidence authority records result, artifact and provenance.

risk_policy.READ_ONLY: Policy may admit without interactive approval only when the capability manifest proves read-only semantics.
risk_policy.MUTATING: Explicit operator approval required before gateway invocation.
risk_policy.DESTRUCTIVE: Preview/diff plus explicit operator approval required; fail closed if unavailable.
risk_policy.EXTERNAL_SIDE_EFFECT: Explicit approval and egress/provider policy required.
risk_policy.UNKNOWN: Fail closed and require planner classification plus explicit approval.

prohibited: direct MCP tool invocation from QML
